name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 63 – Am 70
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 63c. Calls for the reallocation of EU budget funds earmarked for militarisation programmes to support the Member States in improving wages and pensions, ensuring the good standards of healthcare, education, social security and public services, and the right to housing, improving living conditions;
